chapter.verse: Mite in gam ukte leh mangte’ ukna uh a man’ nading, nasepna pha khempeuh a sep nading a kigin’ kholh nading;
kuamah gensia loin, kitawng loin, lungkhuah nei loin, mi khempeuh tungah lungnem takpi nading a ngaihsut nadingun thu na hilh in.

Bang hang hiam na cih leh, nidang lai-inah eite in zong a pil lo mi, thungai lo mi, kheemna a thuak mi, deihgawhna a pawlpawl leh gualnop uukna’ sila i hi a, hazatna, en’na a gamta mi, a muhdahhuai mi, khat-le-khat kimudah mi i hi ngei hi.
Eite Honpa Pasian’ hehpihna leh mite a hong itna hong kilat ciangin,
eite gamtatna pha hang hi loin ama hehpihna bangin nihvei suahna tawh kipawl sawp siangna tawh ahi zongin, Kha Siangtho’ hong bawlphat thakna tawh hong gum hi.
Eite Honpa Zeisu Khazih hangin eite tungah tua Kha Siangtho a kicingin hong sung hi.
Pasian’ hehpihna thupha hangin diktan’sakna i ngah khit ciangin nuntak tawntungna lametna bangin a luah mite i hih nading ahi hi.

Hih thu in thuman thutak ahi hi. Hih thu ngaihsunin Pasian a um mite in gamtatna ahoihte ahih tawntung nading a kikep nadingun, hahkatin na hilh nading ka hong deih hi. Hih thute a pha uh tham loin mite’ phattuamna a piangsak thei uh hi.
Thu kidong hainate leh khangciamtehna laite, kitotnate, thukham hangin kiseelnate tang in. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, tua nate in phattuamna hong pia lo uh hi, a mawkna ahi uh hi.
Thu nial a, kikhenthang mi, khatvei, nihvei bang taai-in na hilh khit ciangin,
tua bang mi in amahmah thu a kikhen manin mawhna bawlin khialhna ahih mi ahih thei-in paaikhia in.

Artemas ahi zongin, Tikhikas ahi zongin, na kiangah kong sawl ciangin Nikopolis khua keima kiangah na hong pai nading na hahkat in. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, tua khua-ah phalbi hun sung teng khawl ning ci-in ka hanciam zo hi.
Sitni Zenas leh Appolos-te in sapna a neih loh nadingun hahkatin na kha in.
I mite in zong a gah nei lo mi hi loin, kisapnate a ngah nadingun, gamtatna ahoih a hih tawntung nadingun sin uh hen.
Keima kiangah a om mi khempeuh in nang hong hopih uh hi. Upna sungah ko hong itte na hopihsak in. Note khempeuh tungah hehpihna thupha om ta hen.
